package learningplanner

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/curriculum"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	maximumResponseBytes          = 1 << 20
	maximumReadinessResponseBytes = 64 << 10
	maximumHandoffResponseBytes   = 64 << 10
)

type Client struct {
	BaseURL       string
	InternalToken string
	HandoffToken  string
	HTTPClient    *http.Client
}

func (client Client) CreateOnboardingPlanHandoff(ctx context.Context, intent domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent) (domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff, error) {
	intent, err := domain.NewTeacherOnboardingHandoffIntent(intent)
	if err != nil || intent.Status != domain.TeacherOnboardingHandoffDispatching || strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" ||
		strings.TrimSpace(client.HandoffToken) == "" || client.HTTPClient == nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable
	}
	requestBody, err := domain.NewTeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequest(intent)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable
	}
	requestHash, err := domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffRequestHash(intent.StudentID, requestBody)
	if err != nil || requestHash != intent.RequestHash {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(requestBody)
	if err != nil || len(payload) > 16<<10 {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable
	}
	endpoint := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/students/" + url.PathEscape(intent.StudentID) + "/onboarding-plan-handoffs"
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.HandoffToken)
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", intent.CommandID)
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	switch response.StatusCode {
	case http.StatusOK, http.StatusCreated:
	case http.StatusConflict:
		code, parseErr := plannerHandoffErrorCode(response, maximumHandoffResponseBytes)
		if parseErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse
		}
		switch code {
		case "idempotency_conflict":
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffConflict
		case "state_changed":
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffStateChanged
		case "active_path_exists":
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffActivePath
		default:
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse
		}
	case http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity:
		code, parseErr := plannerHandoffErrorCode(response, maximumHandoffResponseBytes)
		if parseErr != nil {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse
		}
		validCode := response.StatusCode == http.StatusBadRequest && code == "invalid_student_id"
		validCode = validCode || response.StatusCode == http.StatusUnprocessableEntity && (code == "invalid_idempotency_key" || code == "invalid_request" || code == "not_ready")
		if !validCode {
			return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse
		}
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffRejected
	default:
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: status %d", domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffUnavailable, response.StatusCode)
	}
	if !jsonMediaType(response.Header.Get("Content-Type")) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse
	}
	contents, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, maximumHandoffResponseBytes+1))
	if err != nil || len(contents) > maximumHandoffResponseBytes {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse
	}
	var wire struct {
		Schema              string                                 `json:"schema"`
		HandoffID           string                                 `json:"handoff_id"`
		Status              string                                 `json:"status"`
		StateRef            domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef `json:"state_ref"`
		Goal                domain.TeacherLearningReadinessGoal    `json:"goal"`
		ExecutionStatus     string                                 `json:"execution_status"`
		ContentStatus       string                                 `json:"content_status"`
		ReadinessObservedAt string                                 `json:"readiness_observed_at"`
		Replayed            *bool                                  `json:"replayed"`
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(contents))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&wire); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse
	}
	if wire.Replayed == nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse
	}
	result := domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{
		Schema: wire.Schema, HandoffID: wire.HandoffID, Status: wire.Status, StateRef: wire.StateRef, Goal: wire.Goal,
		ExecutionStatus: wire.ExecutionStatus, ContentStatus: wire.ContentStatus, ReadinessObservedAt: wire.ReadinessObservedAt,
		Replayed: *wire.Replayed,
	}
	result, err = domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff(result, intent)
	if err != nil || (response.StatusCode == http.StatusOK) != result.Replayed {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoff{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse
	}
	return result, nil
}

func plannerHandoffErrorCode(response *http.Response, limit int64) (string, error) {
	if !jsonMediaType(response.Header.Get("Content-Type")) {
		return "", domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse
	}
	contents, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, limit+1))
	if err != nil || int64(len(contents)) > limit {
		return "", domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse
	}
	var envelope struct {
		Error struct {
			Code string `json:"code"`
		} `json:"error"`
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(contents))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if decoder.Decode(&envelope) != nil || decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF || strings.TrimSpace(envelope.Error.Code) != envelope.Error.Code || envelope.Error.Code == "" {
		return "", domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse
	}
	switch envelope.Error.Code {
	case "invalid_student_id", "invalid_idempotency_key", "invalid_request", "not_ready", "idempotency_conflict", "state_changed", "active_path_exists":
		return envelope.Error.Code, nil
	default:
		return "", domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHandoffInvalidResponse
	}
}

func (client Client) ResolveLearningReadiness(ctx context.Context, studentID string, expected domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef) (domain.TeacherLearningReadiness, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(client.InternalToken) == "" || client.HTTPClient == nil || !canonicalUUID(studentID) {
		return domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
	}
	expected, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherStudentReadinessStateRef(expected)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(domain.TeacherLearningReadinessRequest{
		Schema: domain.TeacherLearningReadinessRequestSchema, ExpectedStateRef: &expected,
	})
	if err != nil || len(payload) > 16<<10 {
		return domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
	}
	endpoint := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/students/" + url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/learning-readiness"
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode == http.StatusConflict {
		return domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessStale
	}
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: status %d", domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable, response.StatusCode)
	}
	if !jsonMediaType(response.Header.Get("Content-Type")) {
		return domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
	}
	contents, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, maximumReadinessResponseBytes+1))
	if err != nil || len(contents) > maximumReadinessResponseBytes {
		return domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
	}
	var readiness domain.TeacherLearningReadiness
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(contents))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&readiness); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return domain.TeacherLearningReadiness{}, domain.ErrTeacherLearningReadinessUnavailable
	}
	return domain.NormalizeTeacherLearningReadiness(readiness, &expected)
}

func (client Client) CreateCoursePlan(ctx context.Context, input curriculum.PlanInput) (curriculum.PlanResult, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(client.InternalToken) == "" || client.HTTPClient == nil {
		return curriculum.PlanResult{}, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		DiagnosticPlanID string                     `json:"diagnostic_plan_id,omitempty"`
		GoalCode         string                     `json:"goal_code"`
		DesiredOutcome   string                     `json:"desired_outcome"`
		RequestedTargets []domain.LearningTargetRef `json:"requested_targets"`
		Constraints      curriculum.PlanConstraints `json:"constraints"`
		AuditRefs        curriculum.PlanAuditRefs   `json:"audit_refs"`
		Reason           curriculum.PlanReason      `json:"reason"`
	}{input.DiagnosticPlanID, input.GoalCode, input.DesiredOutcome, input.Targets, input.Constraints, input.AuditRefs, input.Reason})
	if err != nil {
		return curriculum.PlanResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidCurriculum
	}
	endpoint := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/students/" +
		url.PathEscape(input.StudentID) + "/course-plans"
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return curriculum.PlanResult{}, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", input.IdempotencyKey)
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return curriculum.PlanResult{}, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK && response.StatusCode != http.StatusAccepted {
		if response.StatusCode >= 200 && response.StatusCode < 300 {
			return curriculum.PlanResult{}, coursePlanContractError(input)
		}
		switch response.StatusCode {
		case http.StatusConflict:
			return curriculum.PlanResult{}, domain.ErrTeacherGenerationConflict
		case http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, http.StatusNotFound, http.StatusForbidden:
			return curriculum.PlanResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidCurriculum
		default:
			return curriculum.PlanResult{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: status %d", domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable, response.StatusCode)
		}
	}
	contents, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, maximumResponseBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return curriculum.PlanResult{}, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	if len(contents) > maximumResponseBytes {
		return curriculum.PlanResult{}, coursePlanContractError(input)
	}
	if !jsonMediaType(response.Header.Get("Content-Type")) {
		return curriculum.PlanResult{}, coursePlanContractError(input)
	}
	var wire struct {
		RequestID      string                `json:"request_id"`
		GoalCode       string                `json:"goal_code"`
		Status         string                `json:"status"`
		ResultCode     string                `json:"result_code,omitempty"`
		CourseID       string                `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
		LearningPathID string                `json:"learning_path_id,omitempty"`
		Reused         bool                  `json:"reused"`
		Attempts       int                   `json:"attempts"`
		CreatedAt      string                `json:"created_at"`
		UpdatedAt      string                `json:"updated_at"`
		CompletedAt    string                `json:"completed_at,omitempty"`
		Source         string                `json:"source"`
		Reason         curriculum.PlanReason `json:"reason"`
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(contents))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&wire); err != nil {
		return curriculum.PlanResult{}, coursePlanContractError(input)
	}
	createdAt, createdErr := parseCanonicalPlannerTimestamp(wire.CreatedAt)
	updatedAt, updatedErr := parseCanonicalPlannerTimestamp(wire.UpdatedAt)
	var completedAt time.Time
	var completedErr error
	if wire.CompletedAt != "" {
		completedAt, completedErr = parseCanonicalPlannerTimestamp(wire.CompletedAt)
	}
	if !canonicalUUID(wire.RequestID) || wire.GoalCode != input.GoalCode ||
		(wire.Status != "PLANNING" && wire.Status != "COMPLETED" && wire.Status != "FAILED") || wire.Attempts < 0 ||
		wire.Source != "TEACHER" || wire.Reason != input.Reason || createdErr != nil || updatedErr != nil || updatedAt.Before(createdAt) ||
		(wire.CourseID != "" && !canonicalUUID(wire.CourseID)) || (wire.LearningPathID != "" && !canonicalUUID(wire.LearningPathID)) ||
		(wire.CompletedAt != "" && (completedErr != nil || completedAt.Before(createdAt) || completedAt.After(updatedAt))) ||
		(wire.Status == "PLANNING" && (response.StatusCode != http.StatusAccepted || wire.CompletedAt != "" || wire.ResultCode != "" || wire.CourseID != "" || wire.Reused)) ||
		(wire.Status != "PLANNING" && (response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK || wire.CompletedAt == "")) ||
		(wire.Status == "FAILED" && (wire.ResultCode != "" || wire.CourseID != "" || wire.Reused)) ||
		(wire.Status == "COMPLETED" && !validCoursePlanResult(wire.ResultCode, wire.CourseID, wire.Reused)) {
		return curriculum.PlanResult{}, coursePlanContractError(input)
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return curriculum.PlanResult{}, coursePlanContractError(input)
	}
	return curriculum.PlanResult{
		RequestID: wire.RequestID, GoalCode: wire.GoalCode, Status: wire.Status,
		ResultCode: wire.ResultCode, CourseID: wire.CourseID, Reused: wire.Reused,
	}, nil
}

func coursePlanContractError(input curriculum.PlanInput) error {

	return domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
}

func validCoursePlanResult(resultCode, courseID string, reused bool) bool {
	switch resultCode {
	case "COURSE_CREATED":
		return courseID != "" && !reused
	case "COURSE_REUSED":
		return courseID != "" && reused
	case "NO_GAP":
		return !reused
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func (client Client) do(request *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	if client.HTTPClient == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("HTTP client is required")
	}
	noRedirect := *client.HTTPClient
	noRedirect.CheckRedirect = func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }
	return noRedirect.Do(request)
}

func jsonMediaType(value string) bool {
	mediaType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(value)
	return err == nil && mediaType == "application/json"
}

func canonicalUUID(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == value
}

func parseCanonicalPlannerTimestamp(value string) (time.Time, error) {
	parsed, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, value)
	if err != nil || !strings.HasSuffix(value, "Z") || parsed.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano) != value {
		return time.Time{}, errors.New("invalid Planner timestamp")
	}
	return parsed.UTC(), nil
}

var _ curriculum.LearningPlanner = Client{}
var _ repository.TeacherLearningReadinessResolver = Client{}
var _ repository.TeacherOnboardingPlanHandoffGateway = Client{}
